nom: The Crème Shop Totally Clear Blemish Patch Tin

avis.texte: While the patches are very cute, I found that they didn't stick very well which in turn lead to them not being very effective in what they claim to do. I do think they're adorable though, just wouldn't buy them for myself.

I received these patches as a gift for an honest review. I did enjoy the packaging it came in and the cute patches came as different shapes and colors giving me RAVE vibes. The OG patches show when the gunk is pulled out and are a little ugly to wear to work but these patches definitely set the mood. Unfortunately, my pimples are very deep in the skin so I didn't see them being "pulled out" but I did use theses patches for cover up.

avis.titre: Decent - I like that it helps but a bit slow!
avis.texte: I don't really like pimple patches because it takes a bit to work. I usually use spot treatment but these are sometimes nice if I run out or something. The designs are pretty cute and so were the surprise stickers - so it's very cute to use sometimes. But again, it can take a bit for the pimple to go away.

avis.titre: Super cute, not the most effective
avis.texte: I wanted to love these pimple patches because they come in so many cute shapes and sizes! I maybe need to use pimple patches once a week as I try to keep a solid skincare routine but each time I used one of these patches it didn't seem to do much in terms of diminishing the size or appearance of the blemish. I tried multiple sizes in multiple locations and it didn't seem to work for me except to cover the blemish from myself or others seeing it. So while they are super cute and fun, they aren't the most effective product on the market.

These pimple patches are trendy, and I like some of the shapes, although they lean more on the girly side. I have worn these and see puss on the patches or dead skin debris, either way, it's pretty cool to look that they are working. Although there's been times I've had to apply more than one after the first one because it didn't work much. I would say don't expect them to completely remove the pimple/blemish, but expect a significant reduction/improved appearance. The free extra stickers are cool too. I received this free product in exchange for a review. Definitely a handy staple.
Love how fun and cute these are. I'm not sure about effectiveness but I did choose to wear these over the plain ones I had.

I used it during my period when I have occasional breakouts and it really helped calm my skin down. The effects were noticeable after the first couple days! I would highly recommend this product to anyone who breaks out! Def worth a try
I love the little shapes! Reduces redness and size of blemishes.

These blemish patches are adorable but not very functional if you want them to absorb overnight and actually treat the blemish. If your main goal is to prevent picking and cover your blemish with a cute design these may be perfect for you. For me, I find that other patches absorb far more and adhere better. They do come with a cute tin for storage and stickers which is fun addition.
I use these pimple patches while sleeping and they don't budge! The fact that they are stickers is adorable. Cute and effective is the way to go.

These are the cutest blemish patches I've ever seen! The designs are adorable and even come with a sticker sheet. It makes covering a breakout feel way less annoying and kinda fun. They also work really well. They stick nicely, stay on overnight, and help flatten my pimples without irritating my skin. Definitely a fun addition to my skincare routine and I'll 100% repurchase!

** I received this product for free from BzzAgent ** TLDR: Cute & effective but there are better patches out there. Very cute pimple patches! They definitely work and stay on throughout the day/night, however I have tried better. Unfortunately, the better products are ugly and more expensive so this is a good alternative if you just need something cute to cover your pimples. This set comes with one sheet of pastel colored patches, one sheet of silver holographic patches, and a small sheet of paper stickers for decoration (presumably for the metal case they come in). The case itself is a nice quality, I myself will be holding onto it after I've finished the patches :)

I think these are the cutest blemish patches I've ever seen. I like how there is the colorful set and a holographic set. The tin they come in is a bonus for me. As a 30 year old, the designs are a bit much for me to leave the house wearing but I'll happily wear them when I'm at home.
I absolutely LOVEEE this product. I've used other pimple patches before and let me yell you NOTHING compares to these ones . Will definitely purchase.

SUCH CUTE PATCHES! They really make having a pimple a statement. They stick on pretty well and get out some of the gunk from a popped pimple. They come with cute stickers and the tin is so useful in keeping them all together! Would recommend

avis.titre: If your skin is irritated you need a lil color
avis.texte: Loving the crème pimple patches! Love the shapes and the designs pimple patches! It works so well. It's adding colors on lil acne marks! I love the lil cute messages! Be kind, take it easy what a good way to add colors to your skin when they are irritated!
Tin container was cute but the patches weren't what I was expecting. They look very colorful but a little more for younger teens. They also did not work for me.

I love these pimple patches, they are very cute and a perfect gift for a teenager! I use them at night and notice quite a difference in the amount of swelling and redness after removing in the morning. Will definitely buy again!

avis.titre: A Pimple Miracle in a Small Rectangular Can!!!
avis.texte: I received the Totally Clear Blemish Patch Tin (42 ct) at no cost to try and review the product through BzzAgent. I love that the blemish patches come in a cute, pink, feminine metal container to store the blemish patches in so they are safe from dirt and moisture affecting them. Also, the cute little designs they offer take away some of the anguish from the frustrating pimples I am putting them on each time, and add some delight! Seriously though, what matters most is how effective they are. I have tried several different pimple patches - many that have worked pretty well, and some that have barely worked at all at. If found that these were very good at reducing the swelling and irritation of pimples in just a matter of hours. These patches work surprisingly well! Also, they seem thicker than other patches and stay put overnight while I am sleeping.
The sticker is in a tin can. The stickers are small and useful for small puss. It doesn't stick well if your face is too much moisture/oil. It doesn't help with the cystic acne if you have those.

Unfortunately, these patches did not work for me at all. In fact, it seemed like my blemishes looked even worse after using them. The redness didn't go down, and in some cases the area looked more irritated the next day. I followed the directions carefully and applied them to clean, dry skin, but I didn't notice any improvement.
I usually tend to break out frequently. These blemish patches work well and are super cute!
I love the different shapes, it makes using these so much cuter. I wore a few out all day and it looked adorable and when I took it off I could tell it was working its magic all day.

These pimple patches are very cute. loving they are multiple patterns my different moods. They work well for overnight use to reduce redness and inflammation on acne spots. The pink tin is nice for being able to keep them.

This product is truly amazing. I had used a couple of them overnight for some people that I felt were ready to pop, and it sucked the pus out of them. It was so satisfying to see. I love that. It comes with multiple sheets.

Its tin case has been so helpful when packing and moving around. With other patches that only have the plastic protection, the plastic gets all messed up and patches end up getting stuck to random items packed in the same bag. I was skeptical because the patches are on a harder plastic material, but they still worked! I put some on my dark spots to see if it would help and on some small pimples. The patches worked best on the pimples and were able to extract the gunk out. The design is fun I liked the shapes and illustrations more than the word designs (plus the little stickers included were cute). Overall, the patches worked and I liked the tin case it came with! I'd be comfortable buying this in store.

I really enjoyed using these blemish patches! The fact that they came in a reusable tin is really nice and felt high-end. The patches themselves worked well, only 1 came off while I slept and the others stayed in place. I didn't find that they did anything extraordinary or beyond what other blemish patches do, but they're a nice product and work well for what they're made for!
Didn't really like the blemish stickers they were too thick and didn't really do much.

I've tried several pimple patch brands, and this is by far my favorite! Not only are they super cute, but they actually help reduce pimples quickly. I've even noticed a significant reduction in redness, especially with my cystic breakouts. Highly recommend!

I love how cute the designs are of these pimple patches! They are also quite sticky, so they don't move around on your face and stay put. I put these on active pimples and it helps to suck out all the gunk beneath the surface.
These pimple patches are super cute and work super well - my only issue is when i get really oily they slide off :(

The esthetic of this item is so cute, if you aren't into pimple sticker designs then this isn't for you. I have sensitive skins and was hesitant to use this product but I can inform you that it works great and didn't make me break out more. I definitely recommend to give it a try

avis.titre: They are cute, but they work okay
avis.texte: CREME sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. The packaging is a little bulky for the sheets of sticker patches, but the tin is great for repurposing. The tin makes it easy to take on the go or for travel. The sticker designs are cute. I prefer clear ones that make it less obvious that you're trying to hide a pimple. Regardless, I wore 4 different sticker patches consistently over the last 2 days and my pimple slightly decreased in size but it was still very much there. They are comfortable, I forgot I was wearing them. But at the end of the day I would not purchase these again.
Designs of these are so cute, one colored and one metallic. They work well too! I put them on overnight and the help a lot.

these are really great to use as a cover-up, but I didn't really notice any difference after a couple hours of having the pimple patch on. At times I would see little white spots after taking it off and the pimple slightly decreasing. But overall I really liked the design and it did help my pimples not be so exposed.
Literally they're so cute I almost like having pimples (not really) so I can wear them. And they reduce zits pretty quickly.
These hydrocolloid blemish patches have saved my life! They are definetly cute and very effective, I totally recommend this brand 😍✨

These pimple patches are super cute. I love that they include multiple varieties. My favorites were the holographic ones! They work well for overnight use to reduce redness and inflammation on acne spots. The tin is very spacious as well!

avis.titre: Very cute, works like any other patch
avis.texte: Really loved the tin especially, will keep and reuse when I finish the patches and put my own stickers on it! They are extremely sticky and stay on very well, it's actually a bit painful to remove but they're cute enough to make up for it
looks cute to cover up for a pimple but doesn't work unfortunately

Creme sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. I will say I do like how thick the pimple patches are, great for areas that are smoother, but a little bit harder to apply in crevices in which the basic pimple patches adhere better. I did see noticeable improvement in my blemish when applying this product! I enjoy the fun designs of the patches as well, as people have complimented them when I wear them around. If you enjoy fun blemish patches that aren't just for show and work, I would recommend these!

The designs are cute, although some with words are a little extra because of how teeny the writing is. Mostly, I wish they were more malleable or soft. But they stick well and do the job, and have many cute designs. I do super love the tin it comes it, so cute and perfect for storage!

These blemish patches are amazing! The designs are adorable, they stay in place well and help reduce my breakouts overnight. I love the cute tin packaging too, it's perfect to keep in my bag. First time trying this brand for pimple patches but will be a returning customer. *received for free in return to my honest review*

I've used many acne patches before, these are really cute and stay on well! Unfortunately they don't really do what other patches do- which is absorb. They're cute and they worked to prevent me from touching my blemishes but didn't work in healing.

These pimple patches are effective as any other standard patch I've used. They contain hydrocolloid, tea tree, witch hazel, and salicylic acid. It comes with carrying tin, 2 pimple patches sheets and a sticker sheet to decorate the tin. A great gift to teenagers struggling with blemishes.

avis.titre: Clear Skin in a Cute Tin
avis.texte: The Crème Shop Totally Clear Blemish Patch Tin (42 ct) is officially a staple in my routine. The tin is sturdy and way better than flimsy plastic sheets, plus it keeps everything clean in my bag. AND you can decorate it with the cute little stickers included☺️ The patches are thin, super cute and fun, and actually work. I put one on before bed and by morning the spot looks flatter and less red. They stay put overnight and help stop me from picking, which honestly makes a big difference. Adorable, effective, and affordable. I always keep a tin on hand.

avis.titre: Pretty, Protective, and Perfect for painful spots!
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. As someone who gets breakouts every so often I was excited to try these pimple patches! They are super cute! They come in heart, stars, and flower shapes, plus, a "be kind" design. I used one on a pimple outbreak I had, and it really helped to cover and protect it from bacteria. I also noticed reduced inflammation after removing it a couple of hours later. My teenage niece saw them and took a few for herself because she loved how cute they were!

These patches come in a sturdy, practical tin that keeps everything organized and easy to access on my desk, which I really appreciate. I usually wear them overnight and use them on both cystic acne and smaller pimples. I toss and turn a lot in my sleep and tend to rub my face against the pillow, but these patches seriously stay put. Even when I was exercising and sweating, they didn't budge. The edges don't lift at all, which really impressed me. By morning, the pimple looks noticeably smaller and much less red and irritated. I think these work best on cystic acne, especially when worn overnight. For smaller pimples, I personally prefer other hydrocolloid patches. Overall, these are super reliable and work great for more stubborn breakouts. Definitely a staple in my skincare routine. Thanks to The Crème Shop for the free product!

avis.titre: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely in love with these cute pimple patches
avis.texte: I've tried quite a few pimple patch products over the years, and these are definitely some of my favorites. Compared to basic clear patches, these not only work just as well (if not better), but they come in adorable designs that make dealing with breakouts way less annoying and even a little fun!
I love how this product came with a variety of stickers to choose from and looks so leggy on the face, and also does a great job with what it intents to provide.
This product stuck to my face all day. It sucked out the gunk. I love the value of this product as it comes with a bunch of patches with this price point.

I love how these pimple patches come in a cute tin for storing as well as sanitation purposes. It also comes with stickers so you can personalize the tin itself which is so cute. The patches come in a range of sizes and designs (both single and multi colored). I love that they're super kid friendly and positive. The patches themselves aren't super thin, but I don't mind since they aren't made to be invisible. Overall, very cute functional product.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I liked how good they worked overnight. I didn't like the design because I felt like I couldn't wear it out of the house.
had a huge pimple last night, used the blemish patch and this morning woke up to see it signifigantly smaller!
I love the case these come with! And the actual patches themselves are so cute!! I can't wait for use these instead of my boring clear ones!!

avis.titre: So cute pimple patches love it
avis.texte: I received this sample pimple patch and I loved the package. It's so much cuter than many generic pimple patches with the sticker design and the box it comes in. There's a large amount and it has great ingredients including witch hazel which helps after a breakout. I would love another when I'm finish! Would get it again and recommend to acne prone skin.

These are a life saver for me! Whenever I have a blemish or see one starting to form, I pop one of these on, and by the morning, it's gone or has reduced drastically. The super cute designs are a nice bonus!

I loved the packaging tin that these blemish patches came in. I used them for a couple nights now for 6+ hours at night and wow they really do work! Apart from being super cute designs and the perfect sizes they are also really effective and help minimize and heal your acne overnight

avis.titre: This gets rid of pimples overnight - a MUST!
avis.texte: Okay, so I received this product in exchange of writing a review. For context, I am a very stressed post-grad student studying for medical school. I get little pimples pop up here and there, but I've tried other pimple patches and they just cover the issue instead of tackling them. I used only 3 one night - I woke up and PEELED my pimples out. You could literally see the gunk in my pores on the patch after taking it out. It was SOOOO satisfying! The colors can be a bit much, which is why I use them at night. The adhesive is watertight and sticks all night (even with tossing and turning), the designs are cute even if they are bright, and the tin they come in is so cute and very functional. I HIGHLY recommend these pimple patches 🤗

The blemish patches work really well and stay on all night. They're thin and so cute. In the morning, you can see that they pulled out a lot of the stuff from your pimple. My skin also looks less red after using them. The best part is the small metal tin they come in. It's really cute and way better than throwing away a box. You can reuse it or get even more patches. I like that it helps reduce waste instead of adding more plastic. Overall, it feels like a small but good step for the environment and a product I would buy again.

These pimple patches are so cute and have little patterns I LOVE! They stick really well to your face and come with a tin holder you can decorate. After one night, all the pimple gunk was gone and left a little red spot where it's now healing. Overall, 4/5 for everything but the red spot still on my face
These blemishing patches are so cute and amazing. They work super well and come with a great amount to last you for a while. Overall, very cute and useful.

avis.titre: I would buy again and again
avis.texte: I love this it helped with my breakouts so much! And talk about the designs love them felt cute!! Will definitely go stock up on these!
Seriously love these patches, so unique and cute from other ones i've used and pretty good quality. I noticed a slight decrease in one of my breakouts when i put them on before a shift.

avis.titre: The only acne patches you need
avis.texte: I've been using this product for the pimples i have that randomly pop up, it works better than popular ones i have used before. I use it overnight and my pimple is gone! It comes with alot so you don't run out of them.

This product is amazing! Not only does it come in such a cute and portable pink tin that is easy for travel or any other use, the acne patches are also very effective. The patches come in fun sticker like format so it adds a little sparkle to cover the blemish. Highly recommend!

These are some of the best pimple patches I've ever tried. I get a lot of the tiny hard white pimples that can't be popped and these pulled them right out. They are also so adorable. Some of my coworkers thought they were just little stickers. I was wearing for fun.
